principle: No permanent total-event ceiling; every concrete run remains bounded by measured resources, quality, safety, traceability, rollback, and human authority.

decisions.EXPAND: All integrity, quality, resource, latency, throughput, and forced-resume gates pass; propose the next geometric stage.
decisions.RESHARD: Integrity passes but memory or tail latency saturates; reduce partition granularity before expansion.
decisions.HOLD: Recoverability or throughput evidence is insufficient; repeat the current scale after calibration.
decisions.REDESIGN: Duplicates, orphan parents, incomplete subjects, or excessive error rate invalidate promotion.
decisions.STOP: The next stage does not fit the current finite resource envelope; checkpoint and request a new envelope rather than inventing a cap.

mandatory_gates: event count matches the declared stage
event count is divisible by eight
complete subject count matches accepted events
error rate is inside the envelope
forced interruption and exact resume are demonstrated
batch latency and resident memory are measured independently
negative_memory_rules: Never infer resumability from an uninterrupted run.
Never infer complete discovery loops from raw event count.
Never infer exactly-once integration from successful completion alone.
Never hide tail-latency or memory saturation behind average throughput.
Never expand while duplicates, orphan parents, or integrity errors are non-zero.
Never convert a finite resource envelope into a permanent architecture ceiling.
Never interpret generated candidates or workflow fixtures as external evidence.

generator_campaign_bridge.mapping: one generated logical record projects to one eight-event discovery workflow subject
generator_campaign_bridge.boundary: Projection is capacity planning only and does not establish evidence, truth, safety, patentability, or value.

irreversible_actions.physical_experiment: safety review and human approval required
irreversible_actions.personal_data_processing: privacy review and human approval required
